presentation.name: Assess an inherited semantic model before changing it
presentation.summary: Assesses a semantic model and the report on it from the project folder: what is in it, which dependencies make a change risky, and what this folder cannot call unused.
benefits: Builds the inventory that answers what a change would propagate through, including the callers of a user-defined function
Refuses to call a column unused in this report unused, and asks whether other reports share the model
Treats import, DirectQuery, and composite as findings only when the consequence is named
Records performance risks and leaves them for a measurement
Keeps a display-folder rename, a format string, and a description apart, because each means something different
